name: Kingfisher Interpretive Centre
note: Shuswap River spawning channel on the centre grounds: river, gravel bars, grassy bank with bench, forest behind. Shows the place, not the building (no wide, sharp photo of the building exists; site's own photos are under 1100px and show signs/displays).

name: Predator Ridge SIM Lounge
note: Golfer mid-swing in a Predator Ridge SIM Lounge bay, simulator screen, beers on the table, two guests watching from behind (faces in profile, not the subject). Official resort photo; 1920px original.

name: Cabana Beach Campground & RV Park
note: Campground lane with tents, the red cabana shelters, picnic tables and shade trees, Osoyoos hills behind. Clearly the campground.

name: Peach Orchard Campground
note: Peach Orchard Campground gatehouse (timber-frame arch with Canadian flag) with trailers and a tent beside it, willows behind. Matches the entrance in Google Maps photos of 6321 Peach Orchard Rd, so it is definitely the Summerland, BC campground. Original is 4032px (Summerland tourism).

name: Oliver Community Park
note: Disc golf basket #9 fully in frame in the middle of Oliver Community Park, with lawn, path, picnic shelter and trees behind. 1440px (blog photo); lower third is grass.

name: Splash BC Floating Water Park – Kelowna
note: Aerial of the Wibit floating water park on Okanagan Lake: trampolines, slides, climbing pieces and swimmers. Full shot shows the W.R. Bennett bridge (Kelowna); crop keeps the park filling the strip. Posted on the operator's Maps listing (Splash Water Parks Kelowna, 1600 Abbott St).

name: Pelmewash Parkway
note: Pelmewash Parkway: the road under the rock cut with the separated paved lakeside path beside it and Wood Lake on the right, blue sky. 1500px original.

name: Fun 4 Rent (Rent4Fun)
note: Fun4Rent's branded teal trailer (logo visible) at the Gyro Beach lot with its rental kayaks (red, green, teal) lined up on the grass and paddles laid out. Cropped from the only photo on their Maps listing (portrait).

name: Hot Spot on 6th Restaurant
note: Hot Spot on 6 dining room: tufted banquette with tables on the right, main dining room with chandeliers and tables beyond the white rail on the left. No neighbour signage. Replaces the storefront with the Domino's pylon.

name: Kaiso Japanese and Thai Cuisine
note: Kaiso dining room: wicker pendant lamps, red lanterns, booths and tables, counter and kitchen pass in the back, staff and one diner (faces small). No H&R Block sign. Cropped from a portrait photo.

name: Kalavida Surf Shop
note: Inside the Kalavida shop: straw hats on a teal wall, a SUP board on display, thatch trim and apparel racks including a Kalavida-branded tee. Cropped from a portrait photo. Doubt: it shows apparel more than the rental fleet; the only fleet/storefront shots are sign-dominated or have two people cut at the waist.

name: Smile Cycle Tours
note: Their 15-seat pedal bike on a downtown Kelowna street, big SMILECYCLETOURS.CA canopy sign across the top, riders pedalling and waving

name: Peachland RV Park
source_page: Google Maps: Peachland RV Park, 4795 Paradise Valley Dr
note: Aerial of the RV park in the pines: looping gravel roads, RV sites, office buildings and the RV storage lot

name: Island View RV Resort
note: Aerial (file named Osoyoos-RV-Park-Aerial-Photo-Island-View-RV-Resort): rows of RVs across Lakeshore Dr from its beach and two docks, orchards behind. Photographer mark in the corner cropped out

name: Vine49 Wine Tours
source_page: Google Maps: Vine 49 | Kelowna Wine Tours, 1099 Sunset Dr
note: Their silver tour bus side-on, big VINE 49 logo across the windows (tight crop; parking lot, not a winery)

name: Wright's Beach Camp
source_page: Google Maps: Wright's Beach Camp, 4200 Skaha Lake Rd
note: From the hillside: rows of RVs and trucks packed along the Skaha Lake shore, lake and hills behind at dusk

name: Barefoot Beach Resort

note: Two of the resort yurts (teal walls, white roofs) among gardens, a gravel path and a bike; site confirms its Yurt Village

note: Drone view of the marina: row of rental Sea-Doos on the dock, Esso fuel shack, moored boats, hotel behind (matches the aerial on their own site). 1280px wide

name: SWR Boat & SUP Rentals
source_page: Google Maps: SWR Boat & SUP Rentals, 13011 Lakeshore Dr S
note: Four rental Sea-Doos lined up on the dock, lake behind; resort beach at the top of the full photo

name: Noisy Creek Recreation Site (Mabel Lake)
note: The site beach on Mabel Lake in summer: sand, a DAY USE ONLY post, inflatable boat, swim platform and buoy line, forested shore. Slightly smoke-hazy sky

name: Lakers Park Disc Golf Course
note: Basket #9 in the foreground, open fairway with another basket and a bench behind, Vernon's hills on top.

name: Luxury Lake Tours
note: Their boat 'Serendipity' with 'Luxury Lake Tours' on the hull, under way on Okanagan Lake with guests aboard and the hillside behind.

name: DeVino Wine Tours
note: DeVino's black Mercedes van (small DeVino crest on the rear window) parked at Red Barn Winery's yellow and black chevron doors, Oliver.

name: Elite Mile Shuttle & Wine Tours
note: Close-up of their black Sprinter with the door open and the 'Elite Mile' logo large on the side.

name: Cheers! Okanagan Tours and Transportation
note: Their white Cheers shuttle bus, fully branded (wine tours, Myra Canyon, phone number), parked at Hillside Winery's wooden building in Naramata.

name: Signature Connections (formerly Kelowna Concierge)
note: Their white shuttle bus, still lettered 'Kelowna Concierge', parked under the Delta Grand Okanagan sign, which is the listed address.

name: Gostlin Keefer Lake Lodge – Catskiing
note: Two of their snowcats (black cabins with 'Gostlin Keefer Lake Lodge' lettering, red Pisten Bully tractors) on snow, with frosted forest behind.

name: Epic Cycling
note: A rack of their Trek e-bikes with helmets in a Naramata vineyard, Okanagan Lake behind.

name: Grape Escapes Wine Tours
note: Whole branded fleet (Grape Escapes vans, shuttle bus and purple VW bus) with five staff, parked at a Naramata winery above Okanagan Lake. Strip shows the vehicles and logos; staff are small, not the subject. Only 1073px wide (largest on their site), above the 1000px floor.

name: Top Cat Tours
note: Their fleet lined up: shuttle buses with 'TOP CAT TOURS' clearly readable, a coach and a limo. Taken in their yard on an overcast day, not at a winery, but unmistakably this company.

name: Pedego Electric Bikes Oyama
note: A rider on a yellow Pedego Interceptor e-bike with panniers on the lakeside rail trail at Oyama: boat launch dock, lake and hills behind. The rider is the subject at moderate size.

name: Corks & Cactus Tours
note: Their white van with 'Corks & Cactus Tours' and logo, parked at the 'Osoyoos, Canada's warmest welcome' lookout sign above Osoyoos Lake and town. The tire bottoms and the right edge of the sign are slightly clipped in the strip. image_url is the Facebook photo page because the fbcdn link expires. The file came from the 3093x1356 original.

name: Nk'Mip Campground & RV Resort
note: A campground lane lined with RVs and fifth-wheels, with juniper landscaping, desert hills and the Nk'Mip vineyard behind. Taken on a sunny day. From the Nk'mip Campgrounds Maps gallery. A better lakeshore aerial of the RVs exists, but only at 680px.

name: Swiws Spirit Tours
note: Their three branded vehicles (black Sprinter, white Sprinter and shuttle bus), with 'Swiws Spirit Tours' lettering readable, parked under trees with hills behind. The photo has a darkened vignette at the corners from the site's own edit.

name: Cooke Creek Recreation Site (Shuswap River)
note: A summer campsite at Cooke Creek: a screen tent and a vintage Itasca motorhome on the gravel pad, with the Shuswap River and conifers behind. The camper is large in the strip and its BC plate is visible. The other summer options were close-ups of fire pits or a spring river shot.

name: Sun n’ SUP
note: A group paddleboard session on calm Okanagan Lake: about ten paddlers on SUP boards (Red Paddle and race boards) in a circle, with the far shore behind. From the shop's Maps listing. One paddler at the far left edge is partly cut.

name: Pier Water Sports
note: Their yellow-canopy party pontoon with big 'Pier Water Sports' lettering, at the dock with their rental bowriders behind, and Okanagan Lake and the Naramata bluffs in the background. Their beach rental hut photo on Maps was too soft.

name: Oyama General Store Paddle Rentals
note: Oyama General Store's blue building with the 'Oyama General Store / Rural Liquor Agency' sign readable. This is the rental base.

name: Wicked Wine Tours
note: Their black van with the big green 'WICKED WINE TOURS' and 'wicked.tours' lettering, with a smiling couple standing beside it. Weak: the top of the giant 'WICKED' letters is just clipped in the 3:1 strip, and the posed couple takes the right third. This is the only real branded photo. The site's own library is stock-like group shots.
